meta.title: JEE coaching for Class 12 in Pune | D-SAP Ghule
meta.description: A one-year JEE programme for Class 12 students, with JEE Advanced mocks every quarter. Evening classes at New Sangvi and Wakad.

h1: JEE coaching for Class 12 in Pune

intro.text: A one-year JEE programme for students in Class 12. It runs alongside school, from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}.

body.text: Students starting Class 12 who want coaching for the JEE in the year ahead, including those who had no coaching in Class 11.
We do not run a batch for students taking a drop year.
Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics for the JEE, with the material to match.

points.text: Notes and solved examples, chapter by chapter.
Problem sets at JEE Main and JEE Advanced level.

sections.heading: How the week runs
body: Classes start at {{fact:batch.timings#start}}, once school is over, and end at {{fact:batch.timings#end}}.

body.text: Any doubt can go to the forum or the next doubt session. A mentoring slot gives your child one teacher's full attention.
Class 12 students take a JEE Advanced mock every quarter, on top of the monthly JEE Main mock and the chapter tests.
Mocks are taken on our online portal, which works like the real JEE screen, so exam day holds no surprises.

questions.q: Is one year enough for JEE?
questions.a: It depends on how well your child knows the Class 11 topics, which make up much of the paper. If they are in Class 10 now, the [two-year programme](page:class-11-jee) gives more time.
